promptSpec: translate-to-native — type the native language. {prompt:TargetText, answersNative:[1 or more]} e.g. {"type":"translate-to-native","prompt":{"text":"la cuenta","reading":null},"answersNative":["the bill","the check"],"itemIds":["i5"],"explanation":null}
rulesSpec: - translate-to-native: answersNative must cover every natural way to render the prompt in the native language, so a learner who understood it is never marked wrong over a synonym.
paramsSpec: - words: how many words the target-language text in "prompt" should have.
